decisions.detail: equality of ordered pairs: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
first projection / second projection: Other curricula call these the first and second coordinates (components) of an ordered pair.
finite set: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
n(X): Number of elements of a set; other curricula write |X| or #X and call it cardinality.
cartesian diagram: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
arrow diagram: Often called a mapping diagram or arrow (relation) diagram in other curricula.
perpendicular graphical net: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
cartesian product: Other curricula may call X × Y the product set or cross product.
rule of the relation: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary

lo:u1-3-3 'Determine the domain, codomain and range of a function, and find the range as the set of images, a subset of the codomain.': no exercise item or worked example is mapped to it (its practice evidence may be an end-of-chapter item the mappers placed elsewhere)
first projection: Other curricula call this the first element/coordinate of an ordered pair, or the input/x-value.
image: Output value of an element; some curricula say 'value of f(x)'.
range: Some curricula use 'range' for the codomain, or 'image' for the set of outputs.
function value: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
function of the first degree: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
vertex: Other curricula may call this the turning point of the parabola.
axis of symmetry: Sometimes called line of symmetry.
